referenceComposition: Check the connection, then retry from the report action.
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: TraceTitle/Description carry actual step/status/error text; TraceIcon is hidden by the source. Running shimmer, opacity and red color do not replace status wording. Expanded detail is readable native content.
updatesAndDescendants: Trace and line/title/description are passive wrappers. TraceLine status is running|error|pending; there is no automatic successful state, log transport or retry action. TraceTitle includes motion-reduce:shimmer-none. Optional TraceCollapsible/Trigger/Content delegate the actual Collapsible component. Its controlled open prop requires onOpenChange in the wrapper union; defaultOpen remains available. Trigger Enter/Space toggles, disabled suppresses changes, cancellation/control authority follows Collapsible; Escape does not close it and focus is not trapped.
referenceDecision: This family deliberately composes the complete Collapsible reference for disclosure behavior, rather than pretending all trace lines are decorative or inventing an independent trace expansion API. Error/recovery wording is caller content; optional live announcements are task-owned.

naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
protocol: Source-normalized observations project real internal image/scroll state, derived progress, caller-owned upload props or the composed Collapsible protocol. No generic activation callback is invented. Internal lifecycle observations are not public Root events.
